description: This script contains functions and logic for initial device setup, upgrade procedures, image validation, and configuration copying for various hardware platforms within an OpenWRT-based system. It handles device-specific upgrade steps, UBI partition management, and environment setup tailored for different router models.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Initial setup procedure for Asus devices, primarily managing UBI volumes when running on initramfs.

methods.name: buffalo_initial_setup
methods.description: Initial setup for Buffalo devices involving MTD partition management.

methods.name: xiaomi_initial_setup
methods.description: Initial setup for Xiaomi devices, including UBI and U-Boot environment configuration.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function to determine device-specific upgrade process based on board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image before flashing based on device-specific criteria.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configurations during the upgrade process.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific pre-upgrade procedures such as initial setup.
